concept.hr: Mrežna topologija otkrivana korak po korak: lokacije, zone i uloge uređaja
concept.en: A network topology revealed step by step: sites, zones and device roles

summary.hr: Nacrtaj mrežu od uređaja, veza i zona, označi usluge na svakom uređaju i otkrivaj je sloj po sloj. Primjeri: dvije lokacije s AD-om, DMZ, kampus.
summary.en: Draw a network from devices, links and zones, mark the services each box runs and reveal it tier by tier. Samples: two AD sites, a DMZ, a campus.

concept.hr: Sjedište s DC-om, podružnica s RODC-om i IPsec tunel između njih
concept.en: Head office with a DC, a branch with an RODC, an IPsec tunnel between them

concept.hr: Perimetar s dva vatrozida u tri koraka: internet, DMZ, unutarnji LAN
concept.en: A two-firewall perimeter in three steps: Internet, DMZ, internal LAN

concept.hr: Redundantni kampus u tri sloja: svaki pristupni preklopnik ima dva puta gore
concept.en: A redundant three-tier campus: every access switch has two ways up
